title: All pre-release dep pins will break on every RustCrypto rc bump
description: smime-tree/Cargo.toml has 11 exact-version pre-release pins (cms =0.3.0-pre.2, x509-cert =0.3.0-rc.4, rsa =0.10.0-rc.18, p256/p384 =0.14.0-rc.9, elliptic-curve =0.14.0-rc.32, aes-gcm =0.11.0-rc.3, ansi-x963-kdf =0.1.0-rc.2, signature =3.0.0-rc.10). Each new RC from RustCrypto requires a manual coordinated bump of all pins simultaneously or the crate fails to compile. Anyone who tries 'cargo update' will get a broken build. This is routine for RustCrypto monorepo work but creates ongoing maintenance overhead and will confuse contributors who do not know this convention.
close_reason: expected; pre-release pins required for RustCrypto compatibility cluster
